_note: Song ids per level, played in order and looped (Music.playList), any number per level; the Music tab in Service Mode edits these lists. Delivery levels (odd) are upbeat and fast; Kitchen levels (even) are soulfully mellow or solo-danceable. A level may only play songs from its own year or up to 2 years before: build.mjs refuses a newer or older song (the title list is not checked). The release MONTH is advice only (owner, 2026-11-07): every song records the month it came out, and a same-year song released after its level's month (January for a summer level whose winter twin is the same year, otherwise December) is named as a warning by the build and the Music tab, never refused. By owner ruling Level 3 keeps both Bohemian Rhapsody songs and Level 16 keeps Cannonball, though both are flagged.
